blogs.title: Feature Engineering Meets GPT: Introducing FeatLLM
blogs.description: An accessible roundup of the new FeatLLM framework—how large language models can act as expert feature engineers for tabular data, turning raw tables into smart binary rules before any traditional model sees them.

blogs.title: From Questions to Rules: The Two‑Step Reasoning Behind FeatLLM
blogs.description: A deep‑dive into FeatLLM’s prompting strategy that first asks the LLM to understand the problem domain and then guides it to generate decisive class‑specific rules—mirroring how a data scientist would think.

blogs.title: Turning Natural‑Language Rules into Machine‑Ready Features
blogs.description: Explains how FeatLLM parses the LLM‑generated textual rules into executable Python code, creates binary indicators for each sample, and why this step makes downstream models both simple and powerful.

blogs.title: Why FeatLLM Slashes Inference Costs Compared to Traditional LLM Pipelines
blogs.description: Shows how extracting features once lets you replace per‑sample LLM calls with a lightweight linear model at prediction time, dramatically reducing latency and API expenses.

blogs.title: Bagging and Ensembling to Beat Prompt Length Limits
blogs.description: Describes the clever use of feature bagging and ensemble averaging in FeatLLM that keeps prompts short enough for current LLM APIs while still capturing the full signal from high‑dimensional tables.

blogs.title: Few‑Shot Tabular Learning: How FeatLLM Outperforms Classic Methods
blogs.description: Presents experimental results in plain English—comparing FeatLLM against logistic regression, XGBoost, TabLLM, STUNT, and others—highlighting its consistent advantage with only a handful of labeled examples.

blogs.title: Real‑World Impact: Using FeatLLM in Finance and Healthcare Without Massive Labels
blogs.description: Illustrates practical scenarios where domain knowledge embedded in LLMs can replace costly data annotation—showing how banks or hospitals could deploy accurate predictive models with minimal labeled data.

blogs.title: Interpretability Boost: Rule‑Based Features Make AI Decisions Transparent
blogs.description: Explores how the rule sets generated by FeatLLM provide human‑readable explanations for predictions, bridging the gap between black‑box AI and trustworthy decision‑making.
